should therefore use aggregate scores, per-ID correctness or resolution flags, configuration and hashes, 
while excluding questions, offered choices, selected letters, reference keys, traces and example-bearing

new_paragraph: In accordance with the GPQA benchmark guidelines [10], we do not publicly disclose GPQA answers or reasoning traces. Public GPQA files contain only aggregate scores, per-item correctness and resolution flags, configuration and hashes. Questions, options, selected letters, reference keys and example-bearing screenshots are withheld. Authorized researchers can reproduce locally using the upstream dataset. Complete HumanEval+ and MATH500 pre/post answers and review records are released with attribution.

s1_attribution_restoration.old_paragraph: Budget forcing is established prior work. Muennighoff et al. describe forced termination or extension of thinking , together with supervised fine-tuning [5]. This study applies the termination direction to existing checkpoints without additional training. The study does not claim to have invented stopping a reasoning channel. The contribution is an auditable empirical comparison: a generic transferred policy, full-suite source freezes, multiple named grading views, retained regressions, and a distinction between answer delivery and semantic correctness.
